title: Community apps connect accounts and keep generated images
summary:
Two alpha models arrived, community apps got account-connected media uploads, and What’s New stopped being hardcoded.

Product Packaging Designer and AI Dungeon Master added Pollinations account authorization so people can use their own Pollen. Both added Pollinations media uploads, as did Virtual Makeup. AI Dungeon Master also gained an Adventure Gallery for uploaded images and an option to skip uploads when saving.

Dirtberry adds realistic image generation from text prompts. `claude-airforce` adds Claude Sonnet 4.6 to the text API, with image inputs, tool use, and a 200,000-token context window.

What’s New now loads up to five highlights from the news branch instead of a hardcoded list, with clickable links in descriptions. The roadmap lists a planned community Scoring System; the authorization screen also gets a logo contrast fix.

daily.title: Dirtberry image generation
daily.text: Generate realistic images from text prompts with the alpha `dirtberry` model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=dirtberry).

daily.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6 option
daily.text: Use `claude-airforce` for text and image inputs, tool use, and a 200,000-token context window. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=claude-airforce).

daily.title: An Adventure Gallery
daily.text: AI Dungeon Master can upload generated character, scene, story, and inventory images when you save a game, then show them in an Adventure Gallery. You can also skip the uploads.

daily.title: Your Pollen in community apps
daily.text: Product Packaging Designer and AI Dungeon Master now let you connect a Pollinations account to use your own Pollen. Product Packaging Designer and Virtual Makeup also added Pollinations media uploads.
